To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
deep learning is a promising approach to learn generic features from motion data and that these features can be used for action recognition and prediction.

deep feedforward neural networks can be used for human motion prediction, that the features learned by these networks are generic and can therefore be used for action classification and that these features are also useful for motion prediction.
deep feedforward neural networks can be trained to extract generic features from 3D motion capture data that are useful for action recognition and motion prediction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to extract meaningful representations for human motion.
deep learning for human motion prediction and classification.

the following three questions: (1) How can we extract a generic representation of human motion from a large database? (2) Can we use these representations for action classification? (3) Can we use the learned representations for predicting future motion?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method is the state of the art for motion prediction.
the deep learning architecture is able to learn generic features of motion data and is able to predict the motion of a subject with good accuracy.
the deep learning approach is able to extract meaningful features from human motion capture data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that deep neural networks can be used to learn a generic feature representation from human motion capture data.
we propose a deep network that learns to extract a feature representation from a large amount of human motion data.
we have shown how deep neural networks can be applied to human motion prediction and classification.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a deep learning approach to skeletal motion data is feasible and can generalize well to new data.
a deep feedforward network trained with a generic dataset is able to learn a generic representation that can be applied to different tasks and can be used for action classification and prediction.
a deep feedforward network can be successfully used for feature extraction in human motion capture data.
